notes: «وَ» joins six co-transmitters into one level («قالوا حدثنا شعبة» closes it); no «ح» in the text, so one group
«قلت للبراء بن عازب حدثني» makes البراء the one asked and answering (rule 5 and rule 6); the Prophet's words are relayed by him, the last link
«قال فإني أكره» and «فما كرهت منه فدعه» are البراء's own comments, not links
